caseName: Talk America, Inc. v. Michigan Bell Telephone Co.

opinions.text:
C. A. 6th Cir. Certiorari granted, cases consolidated, and a total of one hour is allotted for oral argument.

Justice Kagan took no part in the consideration or decision of these petitions.
